title: GGGODLIN Claude Code Harness — Agent Governance Reference
resourceType: Public reference implementation of Claude Code governance harness
purpose: 參考如何用常駐規則、hooks、skills、commands、agents 與可稽核紀錄治理 coding agent，將人類授權、證據驗證、context compaction 與持續改善從 prompt 自律轉為機制。
recommendation: 適合選擇性研究 gate-authoring、claim-evidence hooks、compact-guard、trial ledger 與 friction log；不要整套直接安裝，原作者明確說明私人接線已移除，部分腳本存在資料刪除、設定覆蓋或未授權執行風險。
notes: Source explicitly calls itself a reference, not a turnkey product. Includes CLAUDE.md/rules, hook enforcement, skills/commands/agents, memory/wiki/trial/friction mechanisms, daily local analysis, and compact-guard with Codex support. Third-party components have separate licenses; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. Avoid directly running destructive commands without auditing.
